cs.notice.items.launch.title: Welcome to Fixora — Apple device repair marketplace in Korea

cs.notice.items.verification.title: Technician verification: only approved shops appear in search results
cs.faq.booking.q1.subject: What is Fixora?
cs.faq.booking.q1.content: Fixora connects customers with verified Apple device repair technicians in South Korea. We are a marketplace — not a repair shop.
cs.faq.booking.q2.subject: How do I book a repair?
cs.faq.booking.q2.content: Search or use AI suggestions on the homepage, open a technician profile, register your device, and create a shop-visit booking. You always choose the technician yourself.
cs.faq.booking.q3.subject: Which booking types are supported?
cs.faq.booking.q3.content: MVP supports shop visits (SHOP_VISIT) only. On-site repair is shown as Coming Soon.
cs.faq.booking.q4.subject: What are the booking statuses?
cs.faq.booking.q4.content: Pending, Accepted, Rejected, In Progress, Completed, or Cancelled. Track progress in My Page and Messages.
cs.faq.booking.q5.subject: Can AI book a technician for me automatically?
cs.faq.booking.q5.content: No. AI may suggest technicians, but you must review profiles and submit the booking yourself.
cs.faq.payment.q1.subject: How does payment work?
cs.faq.payment.q1.content: Pay 50% deposit when the booking is accepted, then 50% final payment when repair is complete. KakaoPay branding is shown in the UI.
cs.faq.payment.q2.subject: Which payment methods are supported?
cs.faq.payment.q2.content: KakaoPay, card, and cash may appear depending on technician and flow. MVP uses a mock payment gateway for portfolio demos.
cs.faq.payment.q3.subject: Is my payment information secure?
cs.faq.payment.q3.content: Production deployments should use your payment provider's secure checkout. Never share card details in chat.
cs.faq.payment.q4.subject: What if a payment fails?
cs.faq.payment.q4.content: Retry from the booking detail page or contact support. The booking may stay unpaid until deposit is confirmed.
cs.faq.payment.q5.subject: Are refunds available?
cs.faq.payment.q5.content: Refund rules depend on booking status and technician policy. Contact CS with your booking ID for help.
cs.faq.customers.q1.subject: Which devices are supported?
cs.faq.customers.q1.content: iPhone, iPad, MacBook, and Apple Watch categories are supported in search and booking flows.
cs.faq.customers.q2.subject: When can I see the technician's phone number?
cs.faq.customers.q2.content: Phone numbers are hidden in chat until the booking is Accepted — for privacy and safety.
cs.faq.customers.q3.subject: How do I leave a review?
cs.faq.customers.q3.content: After a completed booking, open the booking in My Page and submit ratings for repair quality, speed, and communication.
cs.faq.customers.q4.subject: Can I cancel a booking?
cs.faq.customers.q4.content: You may cancel while the booking is still Pending or per platform rules. Check booking detail for the current status.
cs.faq.customers.q5.subject: Do I need an account?
cs.faq.customers.q5.content: Yes. Sign up with email or OAuth (Kakao, Google). Apple sign-in may show Coming Soon if not configured.
cs.faq.technicians.q1.subject: How do I join as a technician?
cs.faq.technicians.q1.content: Choose Technician at signup, complete onboarding, upload ID documents, and wait for admin approval.
cs.faq.technicians.q2.subject: What does verification mean?
cs.faq.technicians.q2.content: Admins review your shop and documents. Until approved, your profile may be limited or hidden from search.
cs.faq.technicians.q3.subject: How do I receive booking requests?
cs.faq.technicians.q3.content: Use the technician dashboard Incoming Requests tab to accept or reject new shop-visit jobs.
cs.faq.technicians.q4.subject: Can I publish repair articles?
cs.faq.technicians.q4.content: Yes. Verified technicians can write community articles and repair stories from the technician portal.
cs.faq.technicians.q5.subject: How are earnings calculated?
cs.faq.technicians.q5.content: Earnings reflect completed bookings and payments recorded in the system. See the Earnings screen for reports.
cs.faq.community.q1.subject: What is the Community section?
cs.faq.community.q1.content: Articles, repair guides, and tips from technicians and customers. Browse at /community.
cs.faq.community.q2.subject: How do I report abusive content?
cs.faq.community.q2.content: Use report tools where available or contact CS. Moderators may remove content that violates guidelines.
cs.faq.community.q3.subject: Can I comment on posts?
cs.faq.community.q3.content: Yes, when comments are enabled on the article. Sign in to participate.
cs.faq.community.q4.subject: Are posts official repair advice?
cs.faq.community.q4.content: Community posts are user-generated. For your device, always confirm diagnosis with a verified technician.
cs.faq.community.q5.subject: Can I follow a technician?
cs.faq.community.q5.content: Yes. Follow from profiles to see updates and find them faster later.
cs.faq.other.q1.subject: Which languages are supported?
cs.faq.other.q1.content: The UI supports English and Korean (locale kr). Backend error messages may remain in English.
cs.faq.other.q2.subject: How do I contact support?
cs.faq.other.q2.content: Use this CS page, in-app Messages for booking issues, or email listed in the footer when available.
cs.faq.other.q3.subject: Does Fixora repair devices directly?
cs.faq.other.q3.content: No. Fixora only connects you with independent repair shops and technicians.
cs.faq.other.q4.subject: Is on-site repair available?
cs.faq.other.q4.content: Not in MVP. It is marked Coming Soon in the product roadmap.
cs.faq.other.q5.subject: Where is Fixora available?
cs.faq.other.q5.content: The product targets South Korea. Search and technician locations focus on Korean cities.
